QUOTE: "The module's own rule is that 'nothing matched' is only a negative once the code has checked the other corpora and found nothing there."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a single-token miss is not proof of absence when the index holds rows in an unread corpus. It also separates "nothing exists" from "I did not look here" through the `not_indexed` signal. It never says this was the earlier behavior, but the mechanism is stated.
